highlights:
Portugal boasts of one of the best midfields in the tournament in the form of Bruno Fernandes, Vitinha and Joao Neves. Bernardo Silva, who plays a much deeper role for Manchester City, is often shifted to the right wing for his country and that could prove to be counterproductive considering that the side’s wingers haven’t had great seasons at club level. But, there is enough pace and trickery on the flanks to make a sizeable impact off the bench when required.

results.title: Portugal vs DR Congo — Match Preview | Fanorate
highlights:
For Portugal, this is the final chapter in the Ronaldo era and the first chapter in whatever comes next. The Seleção carry one of the deepest squads at the tournament, with Bruno Fernandes, Bernardo Silva, Rafael Leão, João Neves and a generation of midfielders that any nation would envy. The expectation is to compete deep into the tournament.
[...]
- A complete midfield combination — Bernardo Silva, Bruno Fernandes, João Neves, Vitinha — capable of dominating any opponent
- An attacking trio that can include Rafael Leão, Bernardo Silva, João Félix and others
- Defensive structure built on Rúben Dias’s leadership
- A goalkeeper in Diogo Costa with elite shot-stopping and distribution

Roberto Martinez has named a 26-man squad that blends experience with genuine attacking depth. Diogo Costa leads the goalkeeper options, with José Sá and Rui Silva in support.

## Predicted Portugal starting XI for World Cup 2026
[...]
Martinez has had Diogo Costa as his first choice stopper for some time now and there is no reason to suspect that will be any different. José Sá will be the understudy.Nuno Mendes and Matheus Nunes are expected to start out wide in defense, with Rúben Dias and Gonçalo Inácio at center-back. Bruno Fernandes will likely play in an attacking midfield role linking the midfield to the front three. Up front, Leão and Francisco Conceição are projected starters on the wings, with Ronaldo through the middle.Predicted Portugal starting XI (4-3-3): Costa; Nunes, Dias, Inácio, Mendes; Vitinha, João Neves; Leão, Fernandes, Conceição; Ronaldo.
